verdicts.human_summary: The heuristic isAgent from std-env auto-detects agent mode and changes core behavior (skips prompts, suppresses dev launch, enables logfile writing). Users have no way to override this if it fires incorrectly. Requests --agent/--no-agent CLI flags.
verdicts.reasoning: AI Comment 12 addresses the same core concern: isAgent from std-env will incorrectly trigger agent mode for users who shouldn't be affected (specifically CI/CD environments like GitHub Actions). Both comments identify that the isAgent heuristic is unreliable and will inappropriately change behavior (suppress prompts, force options.yes, install addon-mcp silently, suppress dev server). While the human requests CLI override flags and AI Comment 12 suggests using the existing detect-agent.ts utility or documenting which env vars are checked, both raise the same underlying insight that the std-env isAgent detection is wrong for this use case and will cause unintended behavior changes for normal users.
